title.orig: RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
title.en: RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol
title.zh: RFC 2324：超文本咖啡壶控制协议

edition.en: The plain-text RFC 2324 from rfc-editor.org, with page headers and footers removed, prose re-flowed and the grammar rules kept in fixed-width blocks; angle brackets around URLs are shown as ⟨ ⟩.
edition.zh: 据 rfc-editor.org 的纯文本 RFC 2324；去掉了页眉页脚，正文重排，语法规则保留为等宽代码块；网址两侧的尖括号以 ⟨ ⟩ 显示。

basis.en: The RFC's Full Copyright Statement (Internet Society, 1998) permits copying and distribution and expressly allows translation into languages other than English, provided the copyright notice and the permission paragraph are kept. The original is reproduced unmodified, and the Chinese translation keeps the notice in full.
basis.zh: 该 RFC 的完整版权声明（互联网协会，1998 年）允许复制和分发，并明确允许翻译成英语以外的语言，条件是保留版权声明和许可段落。原文不加修改地收录，中文译本完整保留了该声明。

note.en: Larry Masinter's April 1998 RFC extends HTTP to control coffee pots, adding a BREW method, an Accept-Additions header for milk and syrup, and error code 418, 'I'm a teapot', which many web servers and frameworks still recognise. It parodies the urge to give every device a protocol and to build everything on HTTP because HTTP is everywhere. The Internet Society's 1998 notice allows translation, so a full Chinese translation stands beside it with the notice kept.
note.zh: 拉里·马辛特 1998 年愚人节发布的这份 RFC，把 HTTP 扩展到控制咖啡壶：增加 BREW 方法、用来点牛奶和糖浆的 Accept-Additions 首部，以及错误码 418“我是一把茶壶”——许多网络服务器和框架至今仍能识别它。它戏仿的是“给每种设备都配一个协议”的冲动，以及因为 HTTP 无处不在就把一切都建在 HTTP 上的习惯。互联网协会 1998 年的版权声明允许翻译，因此这里附上完整中译，并保留了该声明。

excerpt.orig: Any attempt to brew coffee with a teapot should result in the error code "418 I'm a teapot". The resulting entity body MAY be short and stout.
excerpt.en: Any attempt to brew coffee with a teapot should result in the error code "418 I'm a teapot". The resulting entity body MAY be short and stout.
excerpt.zh: 任何试图用茶壶煮咖啡的尝试，都应当得到错误码“418 I'm a teapot”。所产生的实体主体可以（MAY）矮而胖。
